title: Weights and Measures
summary: Weights and measures were used for trade, offerings, land, grain, liquids, and money, and honest measures were a matter of righteousness.
background: Because ancient measures differ from modern units, many passages need background to understand quantity, fairness, or symbolic weight.
teachingHelp: When teaching measures, explain enough to clarify the passage without turning the lesson into a math lecture.
sources: James M. Freeman, Hand-book of Bible Manners and Customs (1874 / early public-domain editions).
